sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Per the file, introduces Vote Account v5, (per the file) the successor to Vote Account v4. Per the file, this is a new vote acct layout designed to facilitate (per the file) zero-copy access, support the (per the file) geo-aware leader schedule and include (per the file) more information about commission rate changes. Per the file, we take the opportunity (per the file) to clean up some (per the file) tech debt from Vote Account v4. Per the file, differences from Vote Account v4: New mandatory location field, for [SIMD-0674]. bls_pubkey_compressed is now mandatory.

Per the file, replaces the votes array (per the file) with a single optional latest_vote. Per the file, replaces each commission rate (per the file) with a commission schedule. Per the file, renames epoch_credits to accumulated_lamports (per the file) and keeps only the last 5 entries. Per the file, dynamically-sized fields are now (per the file) statically-sized for zero-copy access Reduces the acct size from 3762 bytes to 951 bytes. Per the file, adds a rank field, (per the file) which is just a (per the file) placeholder in this SIMD. Those statements are the file’s claims, not a Sol.College measurement of a live cluster.

sections.heading: Motivation
paragraphs: Per the file, there are several reasons (per the file) to make these changes. (per the file) [SIMD-0674] needs a place (per the file) to store each node's location on-chain. Per the file, under [SIMD-0249], a commission (per the file) change made in epoch E (per the file) takes effect from epoch E+2. Per the file, on-chain programs therefore have (per the file) no visibility into the effective (per the file) commission rate of the vote acct, or into when queued-up commission (per the file) rate changes take effect.

Per the file, storing up to 4 (per the file) commission rate changes, with (per the file) the epoch in which (per the file) each takes effect, gives (per the file) on-chain programs visibility into (per the file) the previous epoch's rate, the (per the file) current rate and up to two (per the file) pending rate changes. Per the file, under Alpenglow, historical votes (per the file) are not used, epoch_credits (per the file) have a different meaning and (per the file) a bls_pubkey_compressed is needed for (per the file) all vote accts.

sections.heading: Commission Rate Changes
paragraphs: Per the file, the only way commission (per the file) rate changes are made (per the file) is through the Vote (per the file) program UpdateCommission and UpdateCommissionBps instructions. Per the file, this is because, as (per the file) per [SIMD-0249], the new (per the file) rate will take effect at (per the file) epoch E + 2.

Per the file, if the last entry (per the file) in the array is (per the file) already for epoch E (per the file) + 2, the bps value is overwritten. Per the file, otherwise the new entry (per the file) is appended to the (per the file) end of the list. Per the file, if there are already (per the file) 4 changes, the oldest (per the file) one is removed first. Per the file, old entries are not (per the file) removed when their epoch passes.

Per the file, an entry is only (per the file) removed when a new (per the file) change pushes it out. Per the file, the rate for an (per the file) epoch X is the (per the file) bps of the entry (per the file) with the highest epoch (per the file) that is not after X. The file fails to change the semantics of (per the file) how much delay each commission update incurs. Per the file, it only records extra (per the file) data into the vote acct so that on-chain programs (per the file) can use this.

paragraphs: Per the file, accumulated_lamports is updated the (per the file) same way as epoch_credits in (per the file) Vote Account v4. (per the file) otherwise, adds a new (per the file) entry (E, total + n, (per the file) total), dropping the oldest (per the file) entry if there are already 5.

Per the file, in the Alpenglow migration (per the file) epoch, the first time (per the file) lamports are added, a (per the file) marker entry (u64::MAX, u64::MAX, (per the file) u64::MAX) is added first, unless there (per the file) is one already. Per the file, when the last entry (per the file) is the marker, a (per the file) new entry is always (per the file) added, and total is (per the file) the total of the (per the file) entry before the marker.

Per the file, the conversion copies the (per the file) last 5 epoch_credits entries (per the file) as they are, including the (per the file) marker if there is one.
